$description: Public-facing artificial instrument names, keyed by a style-free SOUND IDENTITY = sha256(family|lowLevel|library|preset|bpm|key)[:16]. Identity deliberately excludes style/addStyles (taste-based classification that changes over time) so a name never moves when a sound is re-tagged. Names are deterministic and pinned: an entry here always wins over regeneration, so hand edits (or xlsx-imported edits) persist. None of these names reveal the underlying sampler/plugin.
generator: catalog/alias.ts@v3 (real-word adjective+noun, probed; style-free sound identity)
